description:
What should we watch? Settle it on the couch.

YepWatch turns choosing a movie or show into a quick game you play together. Start a couch, invite your friends and swipe the same cards from your own phones. When everyone says Yep, it’s a match.

START WITH YOU
Pick a name and answer a few Taste cards: Loved it, Not for me or Haven’t seen. That’s about a minute, and your picks fit you better from the first card. Tune your taste any time from your profile.

GRAB A COUCH
Tap New couch and invite people with a QR code, a link or a short code. Friends can join from the app or a browser. Everyone sees who’s here.

ONE IDEA EACH
A cozy mystery? A twisty heist? 90s action? Everyone adds one idea and the cards follow the mood. Choose movies, shows or both, and add the streaming services you have.

WOULD YOU WATCH THIS TONIGHT?
Every card asks one question. Say Yep or Nope with a tap or a swipe, and enjoy a different reaction almost every time. Your votes stay private. Titles everyone said Yep to become matches.

WHAT ARE WE WATCHING NOW?
Open your matches and tap every one you’re in for. When everyone’s in on one title, tap Watch. Everyone’s in on two? Each person picks a favorite, and if the picks tie, a fair spin decides.

PRESS PLAY
YepWatch checks where your pick is streaming in your country and links you to it.

BRING GOODWATCH IF YOU LIKE
YepWatch works without an account. Optional GoodWatch sign-in brings your taste and streaming services and keeps your couches and past picks on every device. Your Taste answers stay in YepWatch.

YepWatch helps you choose what to watch. Movies and shows play on the streaming provider’s service, which may require its own subscription. Availability varies by country and can change.
